assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states '## Workflow Mode: feature-branch' with rationale citing three atomicity indicators: (1) 'Coordinated schema migrations', (2) 'Cross-cutting refactors', and (3) 'Non-functional requirement — The feature explicitly states: All changes must land together.' workflow-mode-comment.md provides the same decision with detailed rationale.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is Task 1. summary-comment.md confirms: '1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | — | Bookend (create-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is Task 8 (last task). summary-comment.md confirms: '8 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | — | Bookend (merge-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All six intermediate tasks have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-database-migration.md (line 5), task-3-update-seaorm-entities.md (line 5), task-4-update-advisory-service.md (line 5), task-5-update-ingestion-pipeline.md (line 5), task-6-update-integration-tests.md (line 5), task-7-documentation-updates.md (line 5).

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: Task 2 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 3 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 4 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 5 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 6 ('Depends on: Task 1'). Documentation task (Task 7) lists implementation tasks instead: 'Depends on: Task 4', 'Depends on: Task 5', 'Depends on: Task 6' — no Task 1 dependency, which is explicitly permitted for documentation tasks.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md lists dependencies on all intermediate tasks including non-documentation ones: 'Depends on: Task 2', 'Depends on: Task 3', 'Depends on: Task 4', 'Depends on: Task 5', 'Depends on: Task 6'. All five non-documentation intermediate tasks (2-6) are listed. Task 7 (documentation) is also listed.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Intermediate non-documentation tasks 2-6 all contain the required sections (Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify/Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements). Documentation task 7 contains its required subset (Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements). However, bookend tasks 1 and 8 are non-documentation task files that lack 'Files to Modify', 'Files to Create', and 'Implementation Notes' sections. Task 1 (create-branch) has only Repository, Target Branch, Bookend Type, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies. Task 8 (merge-branch) has only Repository, Target Branch, Bookend Type, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies. The assertion makes no exception for bookend tasks.

assertion_results.text: The plan includes a workflow:feature-branch label decision to be applied to the feature issue
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 15: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to the feature issue TC-9005.' workflow-mode-comment.md line 26: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to the feature issue TC-9005.' summary-comment.md: '**Feature label:** `workflow:feature-branch` appended to Feature TC-9005\'s existing labels'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:', not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string
assertion_results.evidence: Digest files exist for all 8 tasks (task-1-digest.md through task-8-digest.md). However, every digest file contains a placeholder instead of an actual SHA-256 hash. The marker reads: '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex-digest-computed-from-persisted-description>' — the string '<64-char-hex-digest-computed-from-persisted-description>' is a template placeholder, not 64 lowercase hex characters. The assertion explicitly requires 'not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string'.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention references in task files use the prescribed rationale format. Examples: Task 2: 'Applies: task creates `migration/src/m0002_advisory_status_enum/mod.rs` matching the convention\'s Rust/SeaORM migration file scope.' Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies `entity/src/advisory.rs` matching the convention\'s Rust/SeaORM entity file scope.' Task 4 has four conventions all with 'Applies: task modifies <specific-file> matching the convention\'s <scope>' format. Task 5 has two such conventions. Task 6: 'Applies: task modifies `tests/api/advisory.rs` matching the convention\'s test file scope.' No inapplicable conventions are listed with 'Not applicable' annotations anywhere in the outputs.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Task Creation Field Values' section: '**Priority:** `{"name": "High"}` (inherited from Feature TC-9005, which has priority "High")'. summary-comment.md 'Inherited Field Values' section: '**Priority:** High (propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created Epics and Tasks)'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Task Creation Field Values' section: '**Fix Versions:** `[{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]` (inherited from Feature TC-9005; `fixVersion scope` not configured in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both" — propagate to tasks)'. summary-comment.md: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created Epics and Tasks; `fixVersion scope` not configured — defaulted to "both", propagating to tasks)'. The plan correctly identifies that fixVersion scope is absent and defaults to 'both', propagating to tasks.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section listing: 'Priority: High (propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created Epics and Tasks)', 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created Epics and Tasks; fixVersion scope not configured — defaulted to both, propagating to tasks)'. Additionally, impact-map.md contains a 'Task Creation Field Values' section with the same information.
